meta.name: canva-automation
meta.description: Automate Canva tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): designs, exports, folders, brand templates, autofill. Always search tools first for current schemas.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成 Canva 设计、导出和品牌模板填充
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Canva 做设计但想省去重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate Canva designs, exports, and brand template filling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Canva for designs and want to eliminate repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动操作你的 Canva 账户：列出、创建、导出设计，上传素材，管理文件夹，以及用品牌模板自动填充数据生成设计。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 处理 Canva 设计任务时触发，例如查找设计、创建新设计、导出文件或整理文件夹。

say.text: 帮我列出我最近修改过的 Canva 设计。
say.note: Claude 会调用列表工具并返回结果。

say.text: 用品牌模板自动填充数据，生成一张海报。
say.note: Claude 会启动自动填充任务。

say.text: 把设计 #123 导出为 PDF。
say.note: Claude 会启动导出并返回下载链接。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can automate your Canva account: list, create, export designs, upload assets, manage folders, and autofill brand templates with data to generate designs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to handle Canva design tasks, such as finding designs, creating new ones, exporting files, or organizing folders.

say_en.text: List my recently modified Canva designs.
say_en.note: Claude will call the list tool and return results.

say_en.text: Autofill a brand template with data to create a poster.
say_en.note: Claude will start the autofill job.
Claude will start the export and return a download link.
